author: Stahly
description:
The Khazalite Holds mega review continues. In part two, we unbox the lords and loremasters of the karaks: the Thrynn, the Runewright, and Ormyr and Ashtongue, the Fyreslayers’ new hero duo. You’ll find high-res sprue images for every kit, and we also take a look at the Magmic Fyrd Spearhead, which holds almost everything the Grimmdron have left in the new Battletome.

The post Thrynn, Runewright, Ormyr: are the new Khazalite Holds characters worth it? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Thrynn, Runewright, Ormyr: are the new Khazalite Holds characters worth it?
